attributes.name: Druva - Integration Configuration Changed Outside Hours
attributes.description: Detects integration configuration changed outside hours in Druva Data Security Cloud events.
author: Druva
tags: Druva Detection Pack 6 – Security Configuration & Integrations

meta.pack: Druva Detection Pack 6 – Security Configuration & Integrations
meta.customer_usecase: Detects integration configuration changed outside hours in Druva Data Security Cloud events.

attributes.query:
FROM logs-druva.event-*
| WHERE (druva.event_type LIKE "Webhook Configuration*" OR TO_LOWER(COALESCE(message, "")) LIKE "*integration*") AND (DATE_EXTRACT("hour_of_day", @timestamp) < 7 OR DATE_EXTRACT("hour_of_day", @timestamp) >= 19)
| KEEP @timestamp, event.id, event.action, event.outcome, event.severity, druva.feature, druva.event_type, user.name, user.email, source.ip, druva.resource.name, message
| SORT @timestamp DESC
| LIMIT 100
